metaDescription: Kevin marks 25 years of the Patriot Act, tying it to Total Information Awareness, Palantir and Anduril, and examines Valinor Enterprises.
summary: This livestream marks the 25th anniversary of the USA Patriot Act, which Kevin argues laid the groundwork for today's surveillance state. He plays an explainer video on the law's provisions, including sneak and peek searches and Section 215, and says Ashcroft's draft was ready eight days after 9/11. Kevin links Total Information Awareness to Palantir and In-Q-Tel, and points viewers to his panopticonindex.com 9/11 page. He then reviews Valinor Enterprises, a defense tech holding company backed by Peter Thiel's network, and discusses X's new product lead Peter Sellis and Elon Musk's transhumanist and cosmist leanings. He also reports streaming glitches and plans for a Discord and a kevinisahuman.com site.
